'''Hanna''', or '''Hanna City''', was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].

==Characteristics==
Originally founded as a fishing village, the city was located on the edge of the [[Silver Sea/Legends|Silver Sea]] and contained the [[Hanna Institute of Antiquities/Legends|Hanna Institute of Antiquities]]. On the city's north side was the [[Brionelle Memorial Military Academy]]. Just outside the city was the [[Hanna Wild Game Reserve]].

Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the city was also the location of a mock-[[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], being used to host roleplays by the [[Legislative Youth Program/Legends|Legislative Youth Program]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the scene of a tragic bio weapons attack, ordered by General [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]].
